tasks.label: debug-up
tasks.command: uv sync --directory backend && docker compose -f docker-compose.debug.yml up --build -d --remove-orphans && for i in $(seq 1 50); do if nc -z localhost 5678 >/dev/null 2>&1 && nc -z localhost 8080 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; sleep 0.2; done; echo "debug stack did not open ports 5678 and 8080" >&2; exit 1
